stretch.name: Stretch
stretch.tip: Stretch the image to fill the Element

tile.name: Tile
tile.tip: Tile the image to fill the Element

clip.name: Clip
clip.tip: Crop the image and stretch it to fill the Element

slice.name: Slice
slice.tip: Cut the image into 9 tiles to fill the Element

horizontal.name: Horizontal
horizontal.tip: Flip image 180 degress from left to right

vertical.name: Vertical
vertical.tip: Flip image 180 degress from top to bottom

both.name: Both
both.tip: Flip image 180 degress from top left to bottom right

uiImage-blend.label: Blend
uiImage-blend.tip: Choose a formula to blend the color with the underlying color

mask.name: Mask
mask.tip: Descendant elements are only visible within the image, and the rendering color is filtered based on the RGB values of the image pixels

uiImage-shiftX.tip:
$Offset X
Horizontal offset of the image texture (unit: pixels)

uiImage-shiftY.tip:
$Offset Y
Vertical offset of the image texture (unit: pixels)

uiImage-border.label: Border
uiImage-border.tip: Image split into 9 parts by border size (4 corners, 4 edges, center). These parts tile to fill the element. Border size = corner side length.

uiImage-tint-3-box.label: Tint - Grayscale
uiImage-tint-3-box.tip: Reduces color saturation (to black & white if high enough)
